summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corp filed an 8-K announcing the completed sale of its interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC (held via Union Insurance Group, LLC) to an unaffiliated third party, effective May 1, 2026. The company estimates a pre-tax gain of approximately $32.3 million, to be recognized in Q2 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or deal structure (cash/stock) was disclosed. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The transaction is already closed, so no regulatory clock remains. What to watch: the exact purchase price and any post-closing adjustments, as the gain estimate may change.
